other_conditions: Applicant must be an eminent artist
Must be a domicile of Tamil Nadu or have resided in Tamil Nadu for at least five years
Should have outstanding records of achievement in Contemporary or Traditional art
Continuous involvement in their artistic field is required
Must have participated in art exhibitions organized by the Government or major exhibitions conducted by others
Should have received awards at national‑level or state‑level art exhibitions
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 and a copper citation plaque.
